verdict.rationale: Lambda documents an official REST API for creating and managing cloud resources, including launching instances programmatically. API launches accept cloud-init configuration and custom base images, and SSH, Slurm and Kubernetes access support non-interactive workloads, so the core of headless automation is covered. The unofficial community CLI/MCP server is a user-built workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI integrations or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions or Terraform), API-token and automation auth guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven CI use.
